1) Best speed-focused editor for pairing/code sprints? (react: :zap: = Neovim, :blue_book: = VSCode, :sparkles: = Emacs)
2) Favorite office model nickname? (react: 1️⃣ Atlas, 2️⃣ Pepper, 3️⃣ Redwood Jr.)
3) Lunch run for today? (react: 🥪 banh mi, 🥗 grain bowl, 🌯 falafel)

liam: Neovim for speed :zap: — 1️⃣ Atlas — 🥗 grain bowl. quick and boring, but true.
anika: VSCode :blue_book: for pair debugging (extensions win) — 2️⃣ Pepper — 🌯 falafel pls.
charles: Neovim :zap: — 1️⃣ Atlas — 🥪 banh mi (too tempted by the cilantro).
nina: Emacs :sparkles: (old habits) — 3️⃣ Redwood Jr. — 🥗 grain bowl.
maya: lol love the Emacs flex nina :joy: — tallying in 20s. thanks for the fast replies!
